stem.text: An L-shape is made from a 15 cm by 9 cm rectangle. A 6 cm by 7 cm rectangle is cut from one corner. What is the area of the L-shape?

options.execution: The child finds the area of the whole 15 cm by 9 cm rectangle, 135 cm², and forgets to take away the 6 cm by 7 cm cut-out. Taking away 42 cm² gives 93 cm².
The child adds the sides of the 15 cm by 9 cm rectangle, 15 + 9 + 15 + 9 = 48, when asked for area. The area is 15 × 9 − 6 × 7 = 135 − 42 = 93 cm².
The child finds both areas correctly, 135 cm² and 42 cm², but adds the cut-out instead of taking it away. That gives 135 + 42 = 177 instead of 135 − 42 = 93 cm².

rebuilds.why: '(not to scale)' dropped (no drawing); sentences split to 16 words or fewer; same maths, option ids and values. Retags: none. Executions written for every wrong option.
